caption:
Moving to Dover? This is the part listing photos never show you: where you'll get coffee on a Saturday.

Kaprichos Cafe at 30 W. Blackwell St is a Colombian cafe and bakery with specialty coffee, open 6 AM to 10 PM daily. Tierras y Sabores at 33 W. Blackwell St, across the street, serves Colombian breakfast from 7 AM (8 AM on Sunday). The Good Bean at 60 N. Sussex St roasts its beans for the shop and opens at 6:30 AM on weekdays.

Before you make an offer, walk Blackwell and Sussex streets on a weekend morning.
